youtube.baslik: What does a tired child's low score really tell us? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Auditory processing tests are very sensitive to attention, motivation and language skills; a low score from a tired or unwilling child may reflect the child's state at that moment more than an auditory problem. So the battery is given when the child is rested, split into two sessions if needed, and behavior during testing is noted. Low results on language-based tests with normal results on tests with little language load suggest language and attention factors.
